title: Everyone Goes To Get Her Tonight — Part 7

series.summary: Rentaro states the plan plainly in the dark playground, the girlfriends agree without argument, and the whole group sets off toward the gates for Hakari.

segments.voiceover_text: Rentaro says it plainly under the lamp. Everyone here loves Hakari, so everyone here goes tonight and brings her out of that house.
Eyes go wide in the dark around him. Nobody argues with it, and a striped phone case tightens inside two very small hands.
One of them reaches over and takes another's hand without saying a word. That quiet grip is the entire agreement between them.
Then Rentaro turns toward the gates, and every girlfriend moves out of the lamplight behind him, straight down the road to her house.
